name: reports-concurrent-run-timeout
goal: Prove concurrent report runs keep separate history and media through peer teardown within the CI time limit.

evidence: CI run 39777141955 at 8d779bcb6 failed the unchanged concurrency E2E after its 900-second timeout.
The existing isolation assertions already cover separate histories, media and teardown; 60 full-suite repeats made CI exceed its limit.
Harness regression 52c72466 recorded the unchanged E2E failing on the 180-second teardown assertion at a7a376e.
Reduce the repeated full suite from 60 runs to one; both run gates continue to hold their own history until checked.
